name: Dan
overview: The topic of Dan encompasses both a person and a tribe in Israel's history. Dan was the fifth son of Jacob and Bilhah, whose name means 'judging,' reflecting God's judgment and provision (Genesis 30:6). He was blessed by Jacob to judge his people and described metaphorically as a serpent that causes the rider to fall, indicating a complex role within Israel (Genesis 49:16-17). The tribe of Dan continued his legacy, with descendants such as Hushim, and played a notable role in Israel's early history, including being a place Abram pursued his enemies (Genesis 14:14) and contributing to the identity and inheritance of the nation.
